verses.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל־ צְפַנְיָה֙ בֶּן־ כּוּשִׁ֣י בֶן־ גְּדַלְיָ֔ה בֶּן־ אֲמַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ חִזְקִיָּ֑ה בִּימֵ֛י יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בֶן־ אָמ֖וֹן מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ă·šer hā·yāh ’el- ṣə·p̄an·yāh ben- kū·šî ḇen- gə·ḏal·yāh ben- ’ă·mar·yāh ben- ḥiz·qî·yāh bî·mê yō·šî·yā·hū ḇen- ’ā·mō·wn me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: This is the word of the LORD that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi the son of Gedaliah the son of Amariah the son of Hezekiah in the days of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah

verses.original: אָסֹ֨ף אָסֵ֜ף כֹּ֗ל מֵעַ֛ל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·sōp̄ ’ā·sêp̄ kōl mê·‘al pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will completely sweep away . . . everything from the face of the earth declares the LORD

verses.original: אָסֵ֨ף אָדָ֜ם וּבְהֵמָ֗ה אָסֵ֤ף עוֹף־ הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֔ם וְהַמַּכְשֵׁל֖וֹת אֶת־ הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים וְהִכְרַתִּ֣י אֶת־ הָאָדָ֗ם מֵעַ֛ל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·sêp̄ ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh ’ā·sêp̄ ‘ō·wp̄- haš·šā·ma·yim ū·ḏə·ḡê hay·yām wə·ham·maḵ·šê·lō·wṯ ’eṯ- hā·rə·šā·‘îm wə·hiḵ·rat·tî ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḏām mê·‘al pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will sweep away man and beast I will sweep away the birds of the air and the fish of the sea and the idols with their wicked worshipers I will cut off mankind from the face of the earth declares the LORD

verses.original: וְנָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עַל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְהִכְרַתִּ֞י מִן־ הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ אֶת־ שְׁאָ֣ר הַבַּ֔עַל אֶת־ שֵׁ֥ם הַכְּמָרִ֖ים עִם־ הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṭî·ṯî yā·ḏî ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·‘al kāl- yō·wō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim wə·hiḵ·rat·tî min- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh ’eṯ- šə·’ār hab·ba·‘al ’eṯ- šêm hak·kə·mā·rîm ‘im- hak·kō·hă·nîm
verses.literal: I will stretch out My hand against Judah and against all who dwell in Jerusalem I will cut off from this place every remnant of Baal the names of the idolatrous and pagan priests

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַמִּשְׁתַּחֲוִ֥ים עַל־ הַגַּגּ֖וֹת לִצְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְאֶת־ הַמִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוִים֙ הַנִּשְׁבָּעִ֣ים לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְהַנִּשְׁבָּעִ֖ים בְּמַלְכָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ham·miš·ta·ḥă·wîm ‘al- hag·gag·gō·wṯ liṣ·ḇā haš·šā·mā·yim wə·’eṯ- ham·miš·ta·ḥă·wîm han·niš·bā·‘îm Yah·weh wə·han·niš·bā·‘îm bə·mal·kām
verses.literal: those who bow on the rooftops to worship the host of heaven those who bow down and swear by the LORD but also swear by Milcom

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַנְּסוֹגִ֖ים מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַאֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־ בִקְשׁ֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א דְרָשֻֽׁהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- han·nə·sō·w·ḡîm mê·’a·ḥă·rê Yah·weh wa·’ă·šer lō- ḇiq·šū ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·lō ḏə·rā·šu·hū
verses.literal: and those who turn back from following the LORD neither seeking the LORD nor inquiring of Him

verses.original: הַ֕ס מִפְּנֵ֖י אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי־ הֵכִ֧ין יְהוָ֛ה זֶ֖בַח הִקְדִּ֥ישׁ קְרֻאָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: has mip·pə·nê ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh kî qā·rō·wḇ yō·wm Yah·weh kî- hê·ḵîn Yah·weh ze·ḇaḥ hiq·dîš qə·ru·’āw
verses.literal: Be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD for the Day of the LORD is near Indeed the LORD has prepared a sacrifice He has consecrated His guests

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּיוֹם֙ זֶ֣בַח יְהוָ֔ה וּפָקַדְתִּ֥י עַל־ הַשָּׂרִ֖ים וְעַל־ בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְעַ֥ל כָּל־ הַלֹּבְשִׁ֖ים מַלְבּ֥וּשׁ נָכְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bə·yō·wm ze·ḇaḥ Yah·weh ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘al- haś·śā·rîm wə·‘al- bə·nê ham·me·leḵ wə·‘al kāl- hal·lō·ḇə·šîm mal·būš nā·ḵə·rî
verses.literal: On the Day of the LORD’s sacrifice I will punish . . . the princes the sons of the king and all who are dressed in foreign apparel

verses.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֗י עַ֧ל כָּל־ הַדּוֹלֵ֛ג עַל־ הַמִּפְתָּ֖ן בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא הַֽמְמַלְאִ֛ים בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנֵיהֶ֖ם חָמָ֥ס וּמִרְמָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘al kāl- had·dō·w·lêḡ ‘al- ham·mip̄·tān bay·yō·wm ha·hū ham·mal·’îm bêṯ ’ă·ḏō·nê·hem ḥā·mās ū·mir·māh
verses.literal: On that day I will punish all who leap . . . over the threshold who fill the house of their master with violence and deceit

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֗ה ק֤וֹל צְעָקָה֙ מִשַּׁ֣עַר הַדָּגִ֔ים וִֽילָלָ֖ה מִן־ הַמִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וְשֶׁ֥בֶר גָּד֖וֹל מֵהַגְּבָעֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḇay·yō·wm ha·hū nə·’um- Yah·weh qō·wl ṣə·‘ā·qāh miš·ša·‘ar had·dā·ḡîm wî·lā·lāh min- ham·miš·neh wə·še·ḇer gā·ḏō·wl mê·hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ
verses.literal: On that day declares the LORD a cry . . . will go up from the Fish Gate a wail from the Second District and a loud crashing from the hills

verses.original: הֵילִ֖ילוּ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הַמַּכְתֵּ֑שׁ כִּ֤י נִדְמָה֙ כָּל־ עַ֣ם כְּנַ֔עַן נִכְרְת֖וּ כָּל־ נְטִ֥ילֵי כָֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: hê·lî·lū yō·šə·ḇê ham·maḵ·têš kî niḏ·māh kāl- ‘am kə·na·‘an niḵ·rə·ṯū kāl- nə·ṭî·lê ḵā·sep̄
verses.literal: Wail O dwellers of the Hollow for all your merchants . . . will be silenced all who weigh out silver will be cut off

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא אֲחַפֵּ֥שׂ אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּנֵּר֑וֹת וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י עַל־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים הַקֹּֽפְאִים֙ עַל־ שִׁמְרֵיהֶ֔ם הָאֹֽמְרִים֙ בִּלְבָבָ֔ם לֹֽא־ יֵיטִ֥יב יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יָרֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bā·‘êṯ ha·hî ’ă·ḥap·pêś ’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim ban·nê·rō·wṯ ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘al- hā·’ă·nā·šîm haq·qō·p̄ə·’îm ‘al- šim·rê·hem hā·’ō·mə·rîm bil·ḇā·ḇām lō- yê·ṭîḇ Yah·weh wə·lō yā·rê·a‘
verses.literal: And at that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish the men settled in complacency who say to themselves The LORD . . . will do nothing either good or bad

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה חֵילָם֙ לִמְשִׁסָּ֔ה וּבָתֵּיהֶ֖ם לִשְׁמָמָ֑ה וּבָנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְלֹ֣א יֵשֵׁ֔בוּ וְנָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁתּ֖וּ אֶת־ יֵינָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḥê·lām lim·šis·sāh ū·ḇāt·tê·hem liš·mā·māh ū·ḇā·nū ḇāt·tîm wə·lō yê·šê·ḇū wə·nā·ṭə·‘ū ḵə·rā·mîm wə·lō yiš·tū ’eṯ- yê·nām
verses.literal: Their wealth will be plundered and their houses laid waste They will build houses but not inhabit them and plant vineyards but never drink their wine

verses.original: קָר֤וֹב יוֹם־ יְהוָה֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל קָר֖וֹב וּמַהֵ֣ר מְאֹ֑ד ק֚וֹל י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה מַ֥ר צֹרֵ֖חַ שָׁ֥ם גִּבּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: qā·rō·wḇ yō·wm- Yah·weh hag·gā·ḏō·wl qā·rō·wḇ ū·ma·hêr mə·’ōḏ qō·wl yō·wm Yah·weh mar ṣō·rê·aḥ šām gib·bō·wr
verses.literal: The great Day of the LORD is near near and coming quickly Listen the Day of the LORD Then the cry of the mighty will be bitter

verses.original: י֥וֹם עֶבְרָ֖ה הַיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא י֧וֹם צָרָ֣ה וּמְצוּקָ֗ה י֤וֹם שֹׁאָה֙ וּמְשׁוֹאָ֔ה י֥וֹם חֹ֙שֶׁךְ֙ וַאֲפֵלָ֔ה י֥וֹם עָנָ֖ן וַעֲרָפֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: yō·wm ‘eḇ·rāh hay·yō·wm ha·hū yō·wm ṣā·rāh ū·mə·ṣū·qāh yō·wm šō·’āh ū·mə·šō·w·’āh yō·wm ḥō·šeḵ wa·’ă·p̄ê·lāh yō·wm ‘ā·nān wa·‘ă·rā·p̄el
verses.literal: That day will be a day of wrath a day of trouble and distress a day of destruction and desolation a day of darkness and gloom a day of clouds and blackness

verses.original: י֥וֹם שׁוֹפָ֖ר וּתְרוּעָ֑ה עַ֚ל הֶעָרִ֣ים הַבְּצֻר֔וֹת וְעַ֖ל הַפִּנּ֥וֹת הַגְּבֹהֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: yō·wm šō·w·p̄ār ū·ṯə·rū·‘āh ‘al he·‘ā·rîm hab·bə·ṣu·rō·wṯ wə·‘al hap·pin·nō·wṯ hag·gə·ḇō·hō·wṯ
verses.literal: a day of horn blast and battle cry against the fortified cities and against the high corner towers

verses.original: וַהֲצֵרֹ֣תִי לָאָדָ֗ם וְהָֽלְכוּ֙ כַּֽעִוְרִ֔ים כִּ֥י לַֽיהוָ֖ה חָטָ֑אוּ וְשֻׁפַּ֤ךְ דָּמָם֙ כֶּֽעָפָ֔ר וּלְחֻמָ֖ם כַּגְּלָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·ṣê·rō·ṯî lā·’ā·ḏām wə·hā·lə·ḵū ka·‘iw·rîm kî Yah·weh ḥā·ṭā·’ū wə·šup·paḵ dā·mām ke·‘ā·p̄ār ū·lə·ḥu·mām kag·gə·lā·lîm
verses.literal: I will bring such distress on mankind that they will walk like the blind because they have sinned against the LORD Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung

verses.original: גַּם־ כַּסְפָּ֨ם גַּם־ זְהָבָ֜ם לֹֽא־ יוּכַ֣ל לְהַצִּילָ֗ם בְּיוֹם֙ עֶבְרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וּבְאֵשׁ֙ קִנְאָת֔וֹ תֵּאָכֵ֖ל כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־ כָלָ֤ה אַךְ־ נִבְהָלָה֙ יַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה אֵ֥ת כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: gam- kas·pām gam- zə·hā·ḇām lō- yū·ḵal lə·haṣ·ṣî·lām bə·yō·wm ‘eḇ·raṯ Yah·weh ū·ḇə·’êš qin·’ā·ṯōw tê·’ā·ḵêl kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ kî- ḵā·lāh ’aḵ- niḇ·hā·lāh ya·‘ă·śeh ’êṯ kāl- yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Neither their silver . . . nor their gold will be able to deliver them on the Day of the LORD’s wrath The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy For indeed He will make a sudden end of all who dwell on the earth
